_comment: What Debloater Pro ships, by content hash, and the version it shipped at.
tools/version-discipline.mjs reads this to refuse a build whose shipped
content has changed while the version has not. Nothing here is exempt:
Pro has no build step and no generated autoloader, so every file in the
commit that changes the shipped code.

history.why: First record: what 0.1.1 shipped, so the version check has a baseline. Pro had no shipped-content manifest and no tags, so nothing could tell whether its code had moved since the version last changed.

0.2.0: the profiles panel, the licence section on Pro's own screen, and the Freemius SDK integration. The shipped code had changed repeatedly since 0.1.1 with the version never moving; this is the release that makes the number true again.
0.2.1: BulkApply deleted (D-0068); profiles table shows type and what a profile applies; portable-profiles copy

0.2.1: re-recorded from a correct build. The first 0.2.1 record was generated from an archive built before the readme short description was corrected, and 0.2.1 has never been uploaded anywhere, so no site has the older bytes.
0.3.0: priority registry updates withdrawn (RegistryChannel removed, priority_registry out of every plan; D-0078); requires the free plugin by its new slug, hakeemify-debloater.
